question.text: Support level in technical analysis refers to:

answer.text: A ceiling the price struggles to breach
A price zone with strong buying interest that tends to stop price declines
A price level targeted by sellers

explanation.text: The Logic: Support is the floor where buying interest halts declines. The Trap: Ceiling is resistance; the other options don't match. Cross-Exam Context: Standard TA content in XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Layer trailing stop-losses just below support to manage downside.
